description_en: You can invoke SwitchToConference to switch the status of a specified call under a specified instance to a three-party conference. This is typically used in scenarios where a consultation is converted into a conference
description_zh: 调用SwitchToConference将指定实例下的指定通话的状态切换至三方会议，通常用于咨询转会议的场景
kebab_example: aliyun ccc switch-to-conference --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --job-id job-241140640196370000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SwitchToConference

parameters.description_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default.
parameters.description_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席。
parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default

parameters.name: user_id
